review_description: Energy Assist (Mike & Juliette) originally supplied my Solar and Inverter, I was familiar with the sales team. The quotes provided from other suppliers were comparable.  I chose Energy Assist because I had used them previously and they provided excellent after sales service for my solar (& also my mother’s solar we used them for her installation also).  I decided to upgrade my inverter to the same company as the battery - SigEnergy.  The installation team did an efficient job in installing the new inverter and battery.  I was originally schedule for mid December, however an opening came up earlier so my battery has now been installed ahead of proposed time.

We were adding a battery and appropriate inverter to an existing 10kW solar system. There was no up-selling or jargon involved and they provided direct, honest advice that respected our budget. we were able to talk to their senior electrician to fully understand our options, and the installation was a masterclass in professional customer relations and old school tradesmanship. The site was spotless when they finished. The independent commissioning and certification was seamless thanks to the friendly office staff, and we have exactly the system we wanted, fully operational in less time than we initially expected. Their price was the best, even adding extra work on the switchboard to enable us to leave the grid very easily, when ready.

Easy & quick response to obtain advice and quotation.Excellent installation process.  Great team who left the property clean & tidy.Company is very hands on providing emails with clear instructions on the  process and next steps, plus who does what and when. Electrical Inspection has just been completed so expect the electricity provider to reconfigure the meter next week. It’s been a seamless process so far.

Mike was helpful with the quotes answering as many questions that I had. It is still important to educate yourself (such as learning from solar quotes website) and know what battery storage and inverter power options you have the pros and cons.The installers did a good job on the install of a Sigenstor system and behaved in a professional manner.So far I have I have not needed to contact customer service but they are available to answer any questions through Phone and email.
They were very flexible with what I wanted , and were able to meet my needs with no fuss .Very pleasant and easy to deal with
Signed contract 4 weeks ago and awaiting installation. It is expected that installation will occur within 5-8 weeks from date of contract.

The whole experience was great with Energy Assist. The quote was competitive and met our requirements for a system that is highly recommended and able to future proof our home. The advice on solar system and battery size was just right for our needs now and into the future. The installation timeline was good, and the team turned up promptly on the day. It was evident they knew what they were doing, and they installed our big system (24 panels and 2 batteries) in one day in a professional manner that instills confidence. After sales support has been reassuring with all documentation managed promptly by the admin team and I feel confident that I can go to them any time I need advice. The system is working great. I highly recommend Energy Assist.

Our journey started warching Finn Peacock's youtube videos. His videos showed enough information for us to easily understand how solar works and how the process of installing. We chose Energy Assist as they gave us a competitive quote and they were easy to deal with. They did not pressure us to choose them and gave us enought time to decide which system to get installed. Our thanks to Mike, Gemma and the rest of the team for being patient with us. We appreciate the effort on getting our solar+battery system installed, plus a good deal.

Mike was informative when quoting, able to adjust system to meet changing requirements. No sales pressure.Aaron and Mitch (installers) were professional, able to site equipment in preferred position.They were on time, kept us informed of the process throughout the day and left the worksite tidy.Gemma (customer service) was able to arrange installation and commissioning of system around our schedule and ensured quick turnaround of all paperwork.Could have been a better demonstration of how app works, but there are YouTube videos and Facebook pages to find answers

Mike was easy to work with in getting a quote. He responded to questions in a timely fashion and wasn't pushy.Their in-house installers arrived on time and completed the work efficiently. They were polite and took the time to explain the work that they were about to perform. Jeroen even found an issue in the next door neighbours' roof plumbing. Aaron the electrician presented the options for the wiring route and always kept me informed. Work was completed within the day and solar savings started straight away.
Energy Assist was fantastic start to finish. Friendly, communicative, professional, efficient and knowledgeable. Honestly can't fault anything. 5-star service.

Salesman was polite and got to the point quickly as to the system that they suggested and they had no problem quoting like for like.Installation was actually earlier than proposed which was good.Admin staff and installation guys were very polite and easy to talk and deal with.  They keep me informed to the status of the job.They left the site with every thing clean and tidy. (wife's garden a little bit damaged but could not install the inventor without)

Keith the salesperson was very reasonable to deal with. He listened to my requirements and followed through with them. He said they're company should be able to install within the month, and they did manage to follow through with that. Everyone from the company I had to deal with were kind and reasonable. The installers didn't muck around, they got the job done, were very polite, and did a neat job. The system performs very well, and I am very happy with going with this company.
Information provided was excellent from the outset. Friendly and prompt service from sales and installation
Quote was very easy. Installation was prompt and workers explained what they were doing as they went. Polite and respectful.Customer service was great and each stage was explained as i went.

Arrived on time on the promised day. Worked through a very hot day to install the system. The inspector came a few days later and the system is up and running. Great to have free air conditioning on a 38c day!

Energy Assist was one of the 3 installers recommended by SolarQuotes. They were the only one to visit our home to discuss the system sizing and installation and provided a competitive quote. We were initially leaning toward one of the others, but Energy Assist were the most responsive to our questions and quick to provide alternative options, so we felt very comfortable in going ahead with them. They initially quoted 5-7 weeks lead time for the installation but the system was installed within 2 weeks. Inspection happened 2 days later, only our retailer was slow to activate our feed in tariff.Overall we were very impressed with Energy Assist's professional service and workmanship. We would recommend them to anyone wanting a great experience throughout to whole process of going solar.

Quoting was great and very informative,Installation was great the guys were terrific and went far beyond supplying exceptional service even by working during the shower of rain fantastic effort guys.Customer service was excellent all the way through the process.A big thank you to all involved
They helped me get the right system, and communication about the installation was clear and they arrived on site when they said. Excellent work.

I chose to go with Energy Assist not only as they are local, but because they have an excellent physical showroom in Croydon where their products are displayed and systems are monitored. The installation of my system went flawlessly and it has now passed its inspection. The only slight issue was with the consultation and subsequent quotation and this was soon rectified - the initial quote was for a system which was probably going to be too small to suit our needs, even though I had explained that it would need to be big enough to be able to charge 2 EVs in the foreseeable future. Otherwise, very happy indeed with our system and with Energy Assist.

Amazing service on time and very efficient. The team very friendly andprofessional. They even kept working during a thunderstorm. Yes they have organised the grid connection. We couldn’t be happier with the service and the professional standard of their work.

Once I used to SolarQuotes option to get 3 quotes, the process was simple, all 3 suppliers came and provided quotes promptly.  Each were using different solar panels, and 2 were using 1 type of Inverter, and the other a different brand.  In the end it came down to the Inverter I wanted (1st Choice) then the best Solar panels (2nd Choice). All prices were thereabouts.Energy Assist arranged the installation date, tradesman arrived promptly and got work immediately.  They told me what they were doing, and asked when they needed to access the roof from inside.  Job completed the same day.  Cleaned up any mess they made.They have arranged for the inspector and changes with PowerCorp, this hasn't been completed yet ... my understanding there is a bit of a back log.

Terrible communication and never followed through with their commitments. They initially provided great and advice and responses right up to the point of paying a deposit and trying to book in install. From then on they were impossible to communicate with to book in an install date. Following install we had problems with one of the components in our system and over 3 months on, Energy Assist still wont come out to fix the problem. Would never recommend or use these guys again. Once your money is paid, forget about getting any customer service again.

Sales and quoting process was clear and straightforward. Pricing was good.Installation was good, although it did require a number of visits to get the panels up and sorted, and same for the inverter.Customer service was good. Not necessarily a criticism as I understand some things take longer than expected, but I thought communication could've been a little better about when the installers were going to come around each time. e.g I was told the inverter install would happen around midday so I made sure I was home then, yet the electrician didn't arrive until 530pm and worked well into the evening which I thought was a bit odd. Either way I'm very happy overall, these guys got it done and did a quality job which is the main thing.The after install paperwork and grid connection was really quick which was awesome!

Not sure yet as the installation is due next month but Mike Sutton and his team at Energy assist seem to be very capable, organized, technically savvy and professionally capableTheir quote was not the cheapest but contained all the necessary requirements for a very capable system that also uses a flexible battery storage systemGreen wave electrical systems probably would have got my business and were very good with their recommendations and system expertise but unfortunately became to busy to quote and installation would possibly be March/April 2022 but they did call and apologize - this interlude did cost me a fair loss of time to then get Mike on board, just a sign of the covid times

Very happy with the system that was installed. The installation of the inverter unit was very tidy and all the cabling nicely routed behind the wall.A small issue with my ceiling where something must have been dropped and made a dent and crack in my ceiling plaster. Not a big deal, but I will need to patch and paint it.
Keith gave me confidence with hid knowledge.Installation done in a day and very happy with it- very well done. Tidy and neat.Only done last week so grid connection not done yet.

Energy Assist has been nothing but professional. I first had a system installed by Energy Assist in 2017 which has been working perfectly. We decided to upgrade to larger system and battery to manage regular power outages in my locality and further reduce energy bills. Their sales consultant, Adrian, provided an honest overview of the system, costs and likely return on investment, and managed the installation process through their terrific office team. Availability of batteries in Australia was difficult due to manufacturer shortages, but Energy Assist informed us up front and installed the solar panels initially, and, once batteries were available, returned and installed the battery backup system promptly. Installation staff were fantastic and clearly new their job. Battery backup system and control panels all look aesthetically  great. I highly recommend Energy Assist and their professional team.

Everything was great. I really appreciated their professionalism. They answered all of my questions. They were really helpful and quick to respond. They had amazing communication and I would recommend them to anyone wanting Solar panels
Quoting, Installation and customer service very good. Still waiting for grid connection, but delay probably due to shortage/busy-ness of electrical inspectors.

I appreciated that the quoting process took place in the property as opposed to using google / near maps as the block / house aren't a standard install.The installation people were polite, communicated when issues arose & provided options on how to work around them.After the installation, everything was tidied up & I wouldn't have known anyone had been working there for 2 x days other than the shiny panels on the roof.After the installation, I had a couple of questions RE the invertor & the response time was fantastic.
Great service and price, really happy with the overall experience.
Kept informed at all times and a neat and tidy installation.  We replaced our SE inverter and added an LG Battery under the Vic Solar Scheme.
I did not qualify for any Victorian Government rebates - so the price may look a little high

Upon investigating different solar companies a few years ago, Energy Assist came out at our first preference. This was based upon the following:1. Their no spin approach to the products they sell.2. The professionalism of their communication3. Their ongoing ability to check in on our system to inform us if it was 'down'.4. Their ability to work with manufacturers of products and swap over our inverter, when it suddenly stopped working.

Sales/quoting process was good and we made a few adjustments to the original quote.We asked for photos of the installation on the roof - that was 4 weeks ago - still no photos but we have heaps of TV interference during the day and a hole in the wall near the switchboard which they also said they'd send a plasterer back to fix - still waiting.They organised most of the paperwork for the grid connections.We were told it could have 2 batteries at time of quote but we went with 1.We've since asked for a quote on a second battery but have been given no answer at first, then told there are none in the country.Starting to think we have used a dud company

Unfortunately the original quote got lost in me SPAM folder, but the sales people followed up via phone to make sure I had the quote. They were receptive to my feedback about their email system and implemented changes. Their quote was a little high but they were receptive to the feedback and had another try. They weren't the cheapest but even early on i could tell they had attention to detail and were focused on a long term relationship.The installation was really fast and the guys were polite and cleaned up after themselves. They weren't able to complete the installation exactly as designed but they worked hard to get the same number of panels on in a slightly different orientation. They consulted me at every stage and did their best to complete the work in the way that I requested. I got everything that I asked for, location of panels, location of inverters and cabling. 100% perfect.Adrian at Energy Assist has been great answering my questions at every stage, before and after installation. He has taken every call answering all of my questions since the install. The team are working hard to get the inspection completed and meter upgraded. They communicate at each stage and I know exactly what will happen next. Couldn't ask for more.
Quick quote, clean and quick installation and excellent customer service.

During a post-covid visit to daughter and family after they had just moved into a new house in Point Lonsdale Victoria,  my wife and I decided to house-warming gift them a solar PV installation. Being new to the Vic solar trends, I consulted Solar Quotes for advice and received a couple of recommendations. My trolling on Facebook and Internet provided other options also.I tested the Solar Quotes vendors and three other competitors. The information flow and research requirements then became exhausting. The Solar Quotes vendors were polite and comprehensive, while the other alternatives became quite competitive and pressing. The other alternatives appeared to be cheaper while offering similar services however in the end, it was necessary to weed out all the different brands and ask all vendors to requote on selected products to baseline the quotations (including the Solar Quotes ones).After achieving this commonality on product to be provided and agreed installation format, all vendors were within a few hundred dollars of each other. I chose a Solar Quotes vendor (Energy Assist Group) as they were the only one to present a representative at the house (being local), were friendly and approachable, and provided a prompt timeframe for installation.They unfortunately were slow in providing the final electrical inspection and were not that helpful in organising the final grid connection to allow the energy produced to be credited to the household bill.Overall a reasonable result.
Worked with us on price to meet budget, sales staff were very good, as were installers. No issues with communication. Are organising grid connection but too early to tell how that will go yet.

No pressure sales process and kept informed of when things were going to happen.Installation was an easy process, no mess and everything was cleaned up and taken away.All paperwork was done with very little that we had to do.

Sales process went well, I received three quotes from your recommendations, all good, and another from a friend.Installation was done well and when promised. As an Architect, I did my own panel layout, which seemed to work fine. Except the sales person and the installer failed to point out the disconnect switches that stick out at the front on my new building. Inspector said to suck it up, they're required.Enphase unit location failed inspection, and had to be moved, which also fixed the poor wifi issue. It took two weeks to organise this, so system is still not completely approved, but it's working. The paperwork should be completed soon.I see my retailer is charging me an average of 35 cents per kilowatt hour, so I'm glad it's in. We'll see what they pay me when I export.Customer service was generally good, if a little slow. Covid19 was blamed, and perhaps that's true, I'll give them the benefit of the doubt.

Energy Assist were very helpful during the sales/quoting process.The installation went well.I am an electrician, so I'm very fussy about electrical workmanship, and they did a very good job.They are assisting in all aspects of the grid connection.The only thing that they could improve on is after installation communication with the customer. I don't like not knowing what the status of grid connection is but maybe that's just me.

After seeking quotes I was contacted by email and a follow up phone call from Energy Assist.  A time was then booked for a salesperson (Company Director) to attend our address.  The salesperson was very experienced, knowledgeable and professional in his approach.  He commented on how well presented our house is and one his opening comment was to the effect that they would not install any solar panels at the front our house as they would spoil its appearance.  The other providers who gave quotes only spoke briefly to me on the phone and then emailed a quote with photos of where the solar panels would be positioned.  These photos depicted their intention to install several panels at the front of the house, which is not what we wanted.   The personal visit to our address by the salesperson and his professional approach is what clenched the deal.  I received a quote a couple of days later, followed up by a phone call from the salesperson.  We discussed the quote at length and following that discussion I was provided with a number of other options to consider, one of which was my preferred option.  I paid a deposit on 23 September but installation was delayed due to COVID-19 restrictions.  I was kept informed of of potential installation dates and the system was eventually installed on Thursday 12 November, 2020.
All aspects of the process were handled professionally,expertly and with excellent communication.Very pleased with this excellent service. I would highly recommend them.
Solid, professional company. Informative quote. Good price and efficient installation. Friendly, respectful, supportive service.

The initial contact with Horst was great and very informative. Their quote was thorough and very competitive. They were easy to deal with the whole way through the transaction.My only criticism would be a lack of communication- I called them to see when they were coming each time as they hadnâ€™t let me know or confirmed. But they were very easy to deal with and the installation was fast and smooth. Highly recommended.

The whole process was simple and efficient - from quote, inspection to installation. Everything occurred as promised. Energy Assist were the only firm that inspected before quoting & dealt with local conditions.

We recently had a 6.4 Kw 20 panel solar system with 5.9 kw inverter installed by Energy Assist. We had a fairly good idea that we wanted to future proof our energy needs as our family grows and allow the possibility of adding a battery later on. I was also mindful of having aesthetically pleasing panels that would add to and not detract from the look of a 30 year old building. We found that Adrian explained the options very clearly and was able to outline the process for us in a quick and concise manner. Installation was quick, tidy and no nonsense and with minimal impact on neighbours. The system is new and we haven't had to troubleshoot anything but we found their back office team to be helpful and quick to get back to us to complete the changeover with our distributor and retailer. So far very good and very much recommended.
Very happy with the service. System is up and running as from today.

Of your 3 quote request companies only 1 quoted they had a different view of the hardware and that virtually eliminated them.I sourced 2 other suppliers and finally chose a local company fully accredited that  been around for about 10 years and was very competitive in their price and had a sound knowledge of what they were offering,My installation is scheduled for 2 weeks.

Battery and panels installed promptly after Quote was accepted. Plenty of information was given about what systems where available.Prompt contact via either phone or email after experiencing minor issues.Solar system is working beautifully as described by Technicians.
Your advice and information on Facebook etc has been invaluable.
Very happy with Horst, the salesperson and installer.Always keeping me informed of progress and followup.Highly recommended.

At this point in time we are up to the install part- currently happening.Customer service so far has been good. Installers seem competent and arrived on time.Still waiting to see if the system lives up to its promises.
Not installed yet. But was the only one of the 3 quotes where the staff made me confident that it was about me and NOT THEM.

They worked with me on layout and options, they did not tell me â€œthis is the only way to do itâ€.  Also, they came and inspected the site BEFORE they finalised a quote.  They did not just sit in their offices and use Google Earth.

No fuss great communication they took time to explain how it all works and best practices to get the most out of it.Next thing on the list is a battery system to store the hours I don't useThanks guys !

The installers Jerome and Chris were very efficient with the installation and paid careful attention to the requirements of my body corporate. They were also willing reduce the cost of the install when we decided not to add tilts due to body corp constraints.Astrid was very pleasant to deal with and answered all my questions over email and phone promptly. I felt like I had a good deal with the Sunpower P19 Panels.

Dealing with Adrian has been a breeze in terms of easiness or asking questions or getting any issues resolved. The system was installed in Mid September and initially had some small technical problems (like you can expect with any new technical products) but Adrian and his team resolved them quickly, once I raised it with them and that is where I liked the effort as now I can know the team behind the company actually cares about the customer rather than just selling something and move on.Since September I essentially have no bills now which is a testament to the product quality and installation. Very happy with the product and the company.

Dealing with Adrian and the team was great from start to finish. The workmanship done on the install was of a high standard and faultless.We had an issue with the inverter not long after install but Adrian put me onto the right person and this was resolved with no fuss. Since the inverter was recalibrated the system has been faultless and we couldn't be happier. I have recommended this company to family and friends and would happily use you again.

Dolf and his team did a great job from start to finish.  We started with a visit to their showroom where Dolf explained the different parts.  He is knowledgeable and gave us different options, without being pushy and was very patient.  He also passed on the savings when prices of parts came down.  The installation was done in an efficient and organised manner.  We were informed of the process and which parts needed our action.  The system was up and running quickly and we could immediately see how it was doing.  All in all, really happy with the outcome and you can definitely trust these guys to do a good quality install.
very good and help fill

panel_brand: dont know the brand  as they were istalled over 10 yrs (Other)

review_description: Not on the grid yet, but it seems to be working well. When it's on the grid and I can monitor the performance it will be easier to rate it, but so far I'm impressed.
It will be good if they assist with setting up the online monitoring software as well.

Admittedly after our previous experiences with solar companies ( both incompetent and crooked one of which took our $900 deposit and disappeared ), most companies would shine, but after contacting your company it was like another world. Everything went smoothly,quickly,and our questions were answered with the whole system up and running within a month from start to completion with the meter recording surplus exported.

Keith Ondarchie is the person you have to remember to talk to when you want to get the solar system from Energy Assist. He is an engineer and he comes to your place to look at the whole setup and feeds you whatever information you need to know without talking about money. After I got the quote, he told me that there was going to be a special deal coming so he told me to wait for it and true enough there were further discounts to the system I chose. He then called me a week later to tell me that he had a customer cancel on him so he need to clear off the panels in his warehouse and if I could confirm my purchase he can come within the week to install the system and also give me a free energy meter plus the discounted price promised! I had my finance approved and as I needed to go on an overseas trip with limited internet, they even assured me to transfer them the deposit or the full sum until I was back from my trip! Energy Assist helped to set up all the work that needed with my energy retailer and all that and Keith even sent me a screenshot of the solar monitoring dashboard to let me know that the system is working well while I'm away. I am truly happy with what Energy Assist has done and I would recommend them highly to anyone I know.

I plan to re-charge my 12 kWh electric car from my solar-charged home storage battery. This requires a big solar system and a battery at home capable of storing 12 kWh. None of the suppliers were familiar with this application and tried to sell me a smaller system which they were familiar with. It was not easy to get my requirement across to them.

System looks great, own consumption generating from day 1, great service and installation.  Still waiting on grid connection (which is up to our Elec co.) , so some time to wait till we see some return, but so far so good.  Dolf and Astrid very helpful, knowledgeable and flexible to needs.
Very slow on paperwork. 3 weeks since installation and papers only lodged today with supplier. I thought this could have happened a lot faster.

Having recently installed a pool and deciding on the option of heating it with a Heat Pump (reverse cycle A/C) we were always intending on installing PV panels to cater for the energy that used over Summer.  I wont pretend we were not initially stunned by the amount of energy the HeatPump (along with the pool pumps) actually ended up using.  We quickly realised that getting a Solar solution was a mandatory aspect of our pool setup not a "nice to have".  What is brilliant is that our usage is perfectly aligned with the output of a solar system and having large east and west facing roof space we will be able to extend our production across a wider period each day allowing us to maximise our personal usage of the solar power.  Hopefully!Contacting solarquotes and getting the 3 providers they recommended has been great.  The only difficulty was differentiating between the excellent service from all 3 providers and deciding on what solution was going to work best for us without over investing and spending more than was absolutely necessary.In the end we have decided on a SolarEdge SE7300 inverter with 34xJA Solar 290W smart panels totaling just under 10kW.  Obviously the inverter is well under the maximum capacity of the panels but since the panels will be split across the East (x14) and West (x20) roof spaces we understood that this would only clip very occasionally.  We will wait and see over Summer!  It was difficult to determine if we were making a mistake here though as another provider made a very strong case for installing 2x5kw inverters to ensure we got the most out of our panels.  In the end we decided (pretty much based on our own research) that the problem with that configuration was that if our 20 west facing panels (5.8kw total) ever ran at full capacity a 5kw inverter would need to clip the output where the 7.3 will not.It was not a huge factor but the other thing that influenced our decision was that the solaredge we decided we wanted to go with was the primary recommendation from the provider we chose where the others were primarily suggesting different products.We are getting our system installed in a few weeks so I will possibly revisit this after that is completed.  I am pretty confident we are going to be very happy with the solution we are putting on our roof.

We had a very positive experience dealing with Keith and his staff.  Everything was highly efficient, we seem to have very good quality solar panels and inverter.  Very smooth operation, excellent installation team and would recommend them to others.
Recommended via family member. Very attentive personal service. Would highly recommend of you're looking for top end.

We elected to add solar panels to two properties, we liked the ability to be able to monitor the solar panel performance from afar and on a panel by panel basis.  We felt that Adrian from Energy Assist explained the process well and provided timely answers to our questions (even over a long weekend).
Excellent service and installation.  Don't want to give the system 5 stars yet as I have not had it long enough but in a month all has been perfect
Pleased we found your site. However a recent post you spoke of price drops for mains supplied power in a couple of years but in your model you have prices rise at 7%pa forever. How soRgds

We are in the middle of the installation - it has stretched out over 2 weeks, partly due to the wrong inverter being delivered, illness of the installer (he did come on Cup Day to help catch up but then had two days off for a wedding), and a delay on delivery of the battery. We are still waiting on half the panels to be installed plus the inverter and the battery. We are not particularly fussed about the delays however they have not been very good with communications!

I was very hesitant at buying solar because I knew very little how it worked and I had heard of bad experiences in purchasing from shonky operators. Thanks to your website, visits to the supplier's showroom and site visits by them, I armed myself with a good understanding of solar. The unit was sized to my need and the installation was done in a day, painless and by top tradesmen. It's been a month since purchase and now I simply look at a webpage to see how they are performing and, at the same time, watch my electricity supplier's graphs which, most days, show that I not only are self-sufficient but putting a few dollars power back into the grid. Overall, a great success.

Dealing with Energy Assist has been hands down the very best experience we have had not only the in the solar panel industry but the best small business we have ever deal with!!! Courteous, prompt, knowledgeable, competitive and honest all because they have a great team of passionate staff. Our installation looked fantastic with the tradesmen going the extra distance to conceal the cabling on our new house.We would highly recommend Energy Assist.

We were initially quoted on 12 panels, but issues with installation on a flat cliplok roof meant they could only fit 10.  The supplier did not make any suggestions for where to put the other two panels, simply said we would pay a lower price - and get a lower powered system.  It was our suggestion to place the other two panels on the tiled part of the roof nearby.  After confirming with the Inverter manufacturer, the other two panels were installed giving us the system we wanted.
Installed and tested, but not on line yet.
Dealing with Keith was great. He knew his stuff and was able to explain it to me in layman terms

I have been very satisfied with our Solar Power process from start to finish.Having little knowledge of Solar Power systems, my initial concern was where do we start? The only thing I knew, was that I didn't want to use the large mainstream suppliers where there is no personalised service and you are just buying a system size with no regard to your individual circumstances or requirements. Enter solarquotes.com.au - what a great site, gave me some good education and most importantly gave me the confidence to request 3 quotes!All 3 suppliers contacted me with 24 hours and all were knowledgeable, down to earth local businesses who have been around a long time and I have confidence that they will around for the future also.Keith from Solar Assist  visited me at home and together we worked out what will be the best system that would meet my aims. Keith is a very personable and knowledgeable man who was happy to educate me and very happy to answer all my rookie questions. Communication between the office and myself was good with a written step by step process sent to me being keeping me well informed of what was going to happen. As a result of the whole "vibe"! I was feeling, I was confident in my decision to go with Solar Assist.Installation lead in time was only a matter of a couple of weeks. Aside from a small delay during installation, this part of the process went very smoothly, the boys did a very neat job and my system was up and running in two days.Well done Solar Assist and solarquotes.com.au  .......Let the sun shine!
Your service made the process straightforward. I felt that I was well informed and enabled me to make the best choice for my needs now and in the future.

I recently had a 3.5 kW JA Solar system with Solar Edge inverter installed by Energy Assist.  While not a budget system, their quote was competitive.  More importantly, their whole installation process and customer service was outstanding.  I first visited their business where their engineer spent about an hour explaining the options (size and brands) available.  Once a contract was agreed, within 3 days the installation was completed on one day (about 6 hours for the 12 panels and electrical work).  I received a comprehensive demonstration on how to use my Wifi to monitor my daily energy generation.  Within 3 days an independent Electrical Safety Inspector checked and approved the system and commented that Energy Assist uses stainless steel cable ties while many other installers use plastic ties which deteriorate over the years and fall off.Energy Assistâ€™s customer service maintained constant communication of each step in the process, including prompt notification to my Energy Retailer required for the final step of updating my smart meter.

The SolarQuotes  webpage is the best source of independent info. ThanksI love looking at my phone to see all the stats from the SolarEdge system in real time...Michael

EnergyAssist have been difficult to contact and are largely unresponsive since my system was installed on 6/3/17. A couple of days later I receive a response saying the paperwork had been submitted to our retailer and it may take a couple of weeks, then you will be notified.  As my energy retailer (Dodo) is not the meter provider (Citipower), I wrote back asking if both have been notified and also as the system had been left on, was I liable to be billed for energy generated by the system since installation without the meter being changed.
